Feature update

Improvement

[**Blueprints Now Show Up on Your Map**](https://intercom.news/companycam/162520-blueprints-now-show-up-on-your-map#)

![Marlene avatar](https://static.intercomassets.com/avatars/9254884/original/Marlene_Avatar_2025-1763488658.png)

Shared by Marlene
• November 04, 2026

Upload multiple blueprints in the web app, place them on your map, and your photos show up on top of the blueprint whenever the locations overlap. That puts the plan and the work in the same view as photos come in. Users have been asking whether they can map photos to blueprints, and this is a first pass at making that simple and easy to do. Every role on your team can use it.

[Learn More](https://help.companycam.com/en/articles/18179254-adding-blueprints-to-the-map)
